**Addition Polymerization Reactions:** Polythene is produced when ethene is heated in the presence of a little amount of oxygen at 1000 atmosphere pressure and $200^\circ\text{C}$ temperature. This reaction is called Addition Polymerization Reaction. In this reaction, ethene is called monomer.

$$n\text{CH}_2=\text{CH}_2 \xrightarrow[\text{little amount of oxygen}]{1000\text{ atm pressure, } 200^\circ\text{C temperature}} \text{(-CH}_2\text{-CH}_2\text{-)}_n$$
*Ethene $\longrightarrow$ Polythene*

**Polypropene:** Polypropene is produced when propene is heated in the presence of titanium chloride at 140atm pressure and $120^\circ\text{C}$ temperature.

$$n\text{CH}_2=\text{CH(CH}_3) \xrightarrow[\text{titanium chloride}]{140\text{ atm pressure, } 120^\circ\text{C}} \text{[-CH}_2\text{-CH(CH}_3\text{)-]}_n$$
*Propene $\longrightarrow$ Polypropene*

Polypropene is stronger and thicker than polythene and can withstand high heat. Ropes, pipes, carpets etc. can be made of Polypropene.

**Polyvinyl Chloride or PVC:** Polyvinyl Chloride or PVC is produced when vinyl chloride is heated at high pressure and high temperature in the presence of organic peroxide. This polymer is widely used for manufacturing various types of pipes, wires, and even medical devices.

$$n\text{CH}_2=\text{CHCl} \xrightarrow[\text{Organic peroxide}]{\text{high pressure, high temperature}} \text{-(CH}_2\text{-CHCl)-}_n$$
*Vinyl chloride $\longrightarrow$ Polyvinyl Chloride*

### 11.7.2 Condensation Polymers

The polymerization reaction in which the monomer molecules release small molecules such as $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, $\text{CO}_2$ etc during their joining one another is called the condensation polymerization reaction. Nylon 6:6 polymer is produced in the condensation polymerization reaction.

**Production of Nylon 6:6:** Nylon 6:6 is produced when adipic acid is heated with hexamethelene di-amene in the presence of titanium oxide.

$$n\text{HOOC-(CH}_2)_4\text{-COOH} + n\text{NH}_2\text{-(CH}_2)_6\text{-NH}_2 \xrightarrow[\Delta]{\text{TiO}_2} \text{(-OC-(CH}_2)_4\text{-CONH-(CH}_2)_6\text{-NH-)}_n + 2n\text{H}_2\text{O}$$
*Adipic acid + Hexamethelene di-amine $\longrightarrow$ Nylon 6:6 + Water*
